note: ORPHAN unreachable from root → BARE DELETE: 'orphan' is present in .nodes but no edge reaches it from root_id 'r' (it dangles). paths_to(r; orphan) is [] → path null/len<2 branch fires: just del(.nodes.orphan), no parent surgery, no collapse. The reachable tree r=[a,b] is untouched. Guards against remove mis-treating an orphan as a child of some node.
